build_fcn_mask_head: build an FCNMaskHead with 4 conv layers and deconv upsampling for 80 class mask prediction
init_weights_fcn_mask_head: initialize FCNMaskHead weights using Kaiming normal for upsample and conv logits layers
forward_fcn_mask_head: run forward pass through FCNMaskHead conv layers and upsampling to produce mask predictions
loss_fcn_mask_head: compute cross entropy mask loss between predicted masks and ground truth mask targets
get_seg_masks_fcn_mask_head: extract segmentation masks from mask predictions and detected bounding boxes with binary thresholding
